resolution: Settled by the authority order. The printed reminder ("If they would enter a bin, erase them instead") has one reading: the card never enters the bin, so it is not trashed. Caleb's "erased instead of ending up in the bin" fits it, the owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“an {Unstable} unit that dies IS…”) itself calls it "the plain sense of the text", and the owner's own words in the owner ruling of 2026-08-29 (“a mod is PART of the…”) ("it didn't go to the bin") argue it too. Print and designer outrank the owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“an {Unstable} unit that dies IS…”), so zones.bin.unstable and keywords.actions.trash.unstable-death state that reading, and the exchange route follows (zones.changes.mods.exchanged says only that the unit and its mods are erased). The engine passes the card through the bin and trashes it: F-U07-6 (CT-246, filed as an owner decision on whether to change the engine). Register fix: mark the owner ruling of 2026-08-24 (“an {Unstable} unit that dies IS…”)’s body-trash ruling, and the owner rulings of 2026-08-25 (“a card entering a bin goes…”) and 2026-08-25 (“the other three ways an exchange…”)’ trash on the exchange route, as outranked by the printed reminder.
